album: Ceres & Calypso in the Deep Time

identity.release_scope: standard 12-track album; distinct from 10th-anniversary expanded reissue

summary.text: A 2013 Candy Claws concept album framed around Ceres, a seal-like creature, and Calypso travelling through deep time; lyrics are credited to poet Jenn Morea.
